en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraj, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said that:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> provided the one-sixth for the grandmother’.
en.sarwar: 11. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, provided for the grandmother with one-sixth.’”
